requirements.text: The product shall plot the data points in a scientifically correct manner.
The grid axis should be labelled correctly according to the input from the data file.
Data points should be coloured in accordance to the cluster number (contained in the data file)
The product should be able to handle up to 2000 data points.
A single click of the mouse over a data point should bring up the name of the data point.
A double-click of the mouse over the data point should cause the application to display all the data point's details.
The product should allow multiple points to clicked so that multiple names can be displayed.
The product should allow the grid to be oriented by the user.
Rotation, zoom and move functions should be employed.

The system shall implement role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure only authorized users can upload or access specific biological datasets, and all data transfers must be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
The system shall validate all input data files against a strict schema and sanitize all content to prevent injection attacks before processing or rendering.
The response to a change in grid orientation (rotation, zoom, move) shall be rendered within 100ms of user input.
The program shall start and render 2000 data points within 30 seconds on the minimum specified hardware.
The response to a change in the grid orientation (rotation, zoom, move) shall be rendered within 100ms of the user input.
The application shall display point details within 500ms of a mouse click event for a dataset of 2000 points.

OPEN: The PRD does not define data retention, privacy, or sanitization policies for the biological data files uploaded by users. - The system shall automatically purge user-uploaded data files after the session terminates or after a maximum of 24 hours to ensure data privacy.

OPEN: The PRD lacks error handling requirements for malformed or invalid input data files. - The application shall validate the input data file format against the specified schema and provide a clear error message to the user if the file is malformed or contains invalid data types.

OPEN: The PRD does not specify behavior or recovery mechanisms for application crashes or session timeouts. - The application shall implement a graceful degradation strategy and log errors to a local file to assist in debugging and recovery.

OPEN: The startup time requirement is conditional on the number of data points but lacks a defined baseline or maximum load scenario. - The program shall start and render the 3D environment for a dataset of 2000 points within 30 seconds on the minimum specified hardware.
